editorial.blurb: Cafe Bionda restores your faith in Italian dining with consistently exceptional, fresh pasta and attentive service that never sacrifices quality for speed.
editorial.insiderTip: Park free in the tight lot out back, and arrive ready to linger—servers may ask about to-go boxes while you're still eating appetizers, so don't let that rush you through the experience.

topDishes.note: Refreshing and light with a surprising sourness that elevates the dish
